source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A white-dragon peak in an endless blizzard: crystalline, cold, fragile beauty, glittering snow and silence. Tempo 84 BPM, 3/4 time, key of F♯ minor. Instrumentation: celesta and glockenspiel melody, harp, sleigh-free soft bells, triangle, thin high strings, soft wind pad. Form: glassy intro, waltz melody, fragile middle, return. Duration: 70 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
